scope: Authenticated catalogue and request forms; read-only DOM and computed styles, plus public CSS copies. Not a complete design system or application implementation.

typography.note: Computed font-family names describe the CSS declarations; font-file delivery and licensing were not evaluated. Values are scoped to the measured components.

publicStaticEvidence.inspection: Targeted CSS slices: primary color, highlight color, chip states, focus-visible and modal rules at max-width 768px.
Targeted color and typography slices; no full stylesheet embedded in this reference.

leanrea.methodUsed: Copy public resources to a temporary directory, inspect narrowly with rg, distinguish static findings from observed UI behavior.

limits: The large index stylesheet timed out; no claim of complete CSS extraction is made.
Responsive intent in CSS does not establish successful mobile behavior at 360px.
No authentication cookies, personal data, private attachment links or university application source bundles are included.
